sloka: भ्रातृरूपो हि मे शत्रुरेषसर्वाहिते रतः ।रावणो नार्हते पूजां पूज्यो ऽपि गुरुगौरवात् ।। ६.११४.९५ ।।
transliteration: bhrātṛrūpo hi me śatrureṣasarvāhite rataḥ ।rāvaṇo nārhate pūjāṁ pūjyo 'pi gurugauravāt ।। 6.114.95 ।।

translations.english: "This Ravana had given up righteous conduct, was cruel, merciless, untrue, and had laid hands on others' wives. I do not deserve to perform obsequies to him.
